title: Executable Dialogue Graph & Governed Action Binding
objective: Represent dialogue nodes, choices, conditions, speaker/participant requirements, transitions and effects as structured content while binding effects only to existing governed Action/Event proposal/execution paths.

scope.purpose: Represent executable dialogue structure while preserving governed Action/Event mutation authority.
scope.completion_gate: Structured dialogue binds effects through existing governed Action/Event proposal/execution paths, and dialogue text never silently mutates canonical state.

selection_boundaries: CNI-04 is completed_verified before CNI-05 implementation.
CNI-05 may compile and traverse structured dialogue using CNI-04 predicate results but may not mutate owner state directly.
Dialogue effects must remain proposals/bindings to existing governed Action/Event paths; they are not executed by CNI-05.
CNI-06+, PCA and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: Establish causal RED before production implementation.
